instructions.title: How it works
instructions.step1: Enter the phone number (Orange or MTN) you want to pay with in the field above.
instructions.step2: Enter the amount you want to pay (for advance payment). By default, the amount is the order's total. The maximum amount for online payments is 500,000 XAF.
instructions.step3: If you'd like to leave a comment, you can do so in the field below.
instructions.step4: Check that everything is correct and click the "Validate order" button.
instructions.step5: A confirmation message will be sent to your phone number for payment. Enter your secret code to validate your payment.
instructions.step6: If you haven't received a message, dial #150# for Orange or *126# for MTN to confirm your payment.

retours.title: Shipping & returns
retours.timeBody: Generally allow 48h for Douala and 3 to 5 business days for the rest of the country.
retours.conditionsBody: You have 48h after receiving your order to report an item that doesn't meet your expectations. The item must be returned in its original condition, unworn and with its tags.
retours.howItem1: Contact us at contact@mstanshop.fr with your order number
retours.howItem2: We'll confirm the process and the return address
retours.howItem3: The item is inspected on receipt before the refund is approved
retours.refundBody: The refund is issued to the same payment method used when ordering, after inspection of the returned item.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.metaDescription: Delivery, payment, orders and returns: all the answers to your questions.

howToPay.question: How do I pay for my order?
howToPay.answer: You can pay by Mobile Money (Orange Money or MTN Mobile Money) when ordering, or choose cash on delivery.

cancelOrder.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
cancelOrder.answer: As long as your order is "Pending" or "Paid", you can cancel it from the "My orders" page of your account.

promoNotWorking.question: A promo code isn't working, what should I do?
promoNotWorking.answer: Check that it hasn't expired and that it applies to the items in your cart. Contact us if the problem persists.

deliveryTime.question: What are the delivery times?
deliveryTime.answer: Generally allow 48h for Douala and 3 to 5 business days for the rest of the country.

trackOrder.question: How can I track my order?
trackOrder.answer: Go to your account, "My orders" section, to see the status of each order in real time.

shipAbroad.question: Do you deliver outside Cameroon?
shipAbroad.answer: For now, our deliveries are only within Cameroon. Write to us for any specific request.

canReturn.question: Can I return an item?
canReturn.answer: Contact us within 48h of receipt if an item doesn't meet your expectations.

howRefund.question: How does a refund work?
howRefund.answer: Once the item is returned and inspected, the refund is issued to the same payment method used for the order. See our return policy for the full timeline.
